findings.title: Important Notice Regarding EBT Services
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Union County is aware of the long lines and increased wait times at the Elizabeth Social Services office due to a State system error.
findings.summary: Union County reports that a state system error caused long lines and increased waiting times at its Elizabeth Social Services office; residents seeking replacement EBT cards face delayed in-person assistance. The notice does not say retail EBT transactions failed or that benefits themselves stopped. Notice is dated November 4 but does not expose an hour, so first publication within this watch interval is not established; newly surfaced to this supplementary watch and requires editorial deduplication and timing review.
findings.scope: Union County Elizabeth Social Services office; possible state system origin, geographic reach beyond office unverified
affected_groups: Residents requiring in-person Social Services assistance
